mechanism: Venlafaxine inhibits CYP2D6 and may increase fluphenazine levels; combined serotonergic and dopamine antagonism increases risk of serotonin syndrome and neuroleptic malignant syndrome.
action: Monitor closely for extrapyramidal symptoms, rigidity, hyperthermia, and serotonin syndrome; consider dose adjustment or alternative antipsychotic with lower CYP2D6 metabolism.
